 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH  ORAL ORDER 2 19-10-2023 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. Petitioner apprehends arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 467,
468, 471, 406, 420 and 120(B) of the Indian Penal Code.

3. It is alleged that all the F.I.R. named accused persons including this petitioner conspired and misappropriated huge amount of money of the informant Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.67555 of 2023(2) dt.19-10-2023 by executing sale deed of a land which was already sold to three other persons prior to the informant.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner is neither purchaser nor vendor of the Subhash Chandra Jha vs The State Of Bihar on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/81258867/
1 alleged land.

entities.text: Subhash Chandra Jha vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Petitioner is only alleged to have assisted the husband of the informant in purchasing the land in question and not a single money has been transferred in the account of the petitioner.
5. Learned counsel for the informant vehemently opposes the bail application.

6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, this anticipatory bail is allowed and it is ordered that let the above named petitioner in the event of his arrest/surrender before the court below within a period of six weeks from today, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail-bond of Rs.
10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Purnia in connection with K. Hat P.S. Patna High Court CR.
